role: Independent final decision reviewer under Astra harness Phase 08

independence.work: Read frozen candidates, derivations, selected primary MES text, code and execution receipts; authored only bounded independent reviewer checks and decisions.
independence.shared_context: Shared workspace and owner brief; not blind to author claims. Independence concerns candidate authorship and decision role, not an independently acquired observational dataset.
independence.model_identity: Inherited host settings; no separate model/effort certification

approved_next_stage: Bounded theory/observational-contract development and a synthetic response/nuisance identifiability fixture; no universal or actual-observation claim.

criteria.evidence: Candidate definitions and proofs are explicit, exact arithmetic source/receipts/results are consistent, MES formula/hypothesis scope is source-supported; 8 Fraction identities and the 6 Wolfram residual groups are not conflated.
criteria.physical_math_validity: Optical projection signs, physical c factors, sphere inverses, least-squares norm bound, weak-kernel coefficients, boost laws, Raychaudhuri boundary term and tensor gauge/pushforward formulas are consistent in stated scope. Corrected centered constraint is now consistent.
criteria.novelty: Unresolved; this review is not a novelty/prior-art certification. No priority claim is admitted.
criteria.testability: The operator identities and observable-response ranks are falsifiable finite targets. Actual observations require physically derived responses and bounded radiation/source derivatives.
criteria.robustness: Frame/connection, parity, nullspace, source nuisance, unbounded or zero radii, same-data normalization, confidence calibration and leading-order MES limitations are retained.
criteria.tractability: Finite local jets, weak moments, analytic/integral constraints and small matrix problems support a next bounded step without ODE/PDE/Boltzmann evolution.
criteria.assumptions: No Bianchi class is selected. Structure constants alone do not fix a metric or dynamics. General geometric identities are distinguished from conditional physics and source assumptions.
criteria.original_motivation: A common theoretical-budget fraction 100(1-gamma) compares sectors while signed tensor information, morphology and redshift/frame contracts are retained. Sector fractions and joint gauge, and budget fairness versus significance, are distinguished.

findings.description: Physical constrained set is now k_ref+B, not uncentered B. V1 finding and counterexample are preserved.
Riemann/Ricci convention is explicitly fixed for Raychaudhuri.
V3 distinguishes 8 exact Fraction identities from 6 separate Wolfram residual groups.

evidence_states.MES_geodesic_first_order_rows: literature-supported conditional references; not exact finite-anisotropy bounds

claim_ceiling: Not a universal nonlinear almost-FLRW/MES theorem.
Not a bound on all kinematics from a single static CMB sky.
Not actual CMB data inference or measured deviation percentage.
Not a theorem that redshift labels alone separate local boost and global tilt.
Not a globally realizable Einstein-matter solution from arbitrary Lie algebra or local jets.
No independent execution of the entire author suite is claimed.
next_acceptance: Choose one fixed observable/frame/source experiment and derive its finite response with a controlled remainder.
Supply physically justified bounded residual/source sets, and state which measured combinations thereby have finite radii.
Report nuisance-projected rank/null vectors before separate sector posteriors; use projection of the joint allowed body.
Propagate the same-sky numerator/denominator jointly and calibrate the induced statistic law.
